test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In 10 years from now, A will be twice as old as B was 10 years ago. If A is 9 years older than B, find the present age of A.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let B present age = x, then A = x + 9.

Age of A in 10 yrs = x + 19; Age of B 10 yrs ago = x − 10.

According to question: x + 19 = 2 × (x − 10).

⇒ x + 19 = 2x − 20 ⇒ x = 39.

Present age of A = 39 + 9 = 48 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between A and B = 9 years ⇒ A − B = 9

Relation in 10 years: (A + 10) = 2 × (B − 10)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1d24fa82924bf0fd2ea5ee1d0aeed4ce8bf94863fb6bf2eded6a30abefae385.png] 

**Calculations:**

From the first relation, B = A − 9.

Substitute B in the second equation:

⇒ A + 10 = 2 × ((A − 9) − 10)

⇒ A + 10 = 2 × (A − 19)

⇒ A + 10 = 2A − 38

⇒ 10 + 38 = 2A − A

⇒ A = 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two people remains constant regardless of the number of years passed or preceded.

Age Ratio Concept

If the ratio of ages is x:y, their actual ages can be represented as kx and ky, where k is a common constant.

Future and Past Ages

If present age is P, age after n years is P + n and age n years ago was P − n.
